concerns.text: PR #467 diff and docs/architecture/contingent-registry-adr.md were not included in the review context (and tool calls are disabled), so the ADR contents (SQLite DDL, canonical enum normalization, SHA-256/order-key deduplication rules, deterministic SQL rollups, and slot [11] contract) could not be directly verified against the Acceptance Criteria. Note also that crie_persistent_memory.py and crie_document_parser.py are not yet present in the base repository file tree.
